name: Cyberpunk Sheet
author: local
description: Bar-icon-driven Cyberpunk 2020 character sheet editor. Edits like the PDF, exports plain text for LLM roleplay. Stays open until X closes it (pin blocks closing). Theme-aware.

barWidget.description: Bar icon toggles the character sheet card. Right-click for placement + output settings. Card stays open until X (pin blocks closing).
